rows.col_1: POST https://developer.api.autodesk.com/bim360/assets/v1/projects/{projectId}/categories:batch-get
user context required
data:read
JSON
Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is obtained via a three-legged OAuth flow.
Must be application/json
The BIM 360 project ID. Must be a UUID or a project ID of the form “b.{UUID}”.

If provided, and set to true, the globally-unique category uid field will be present in the response.
The globally unique category ID is used with the (upcoming) v3 category APIs. The option to include the
globally-unique ID with the v1 category APIs is to help consumers transition to the new IDs.
Unique IDs of categories to fetch
Successfully returned a batch of categories.

Returned categories
The ID of the category. This is a numeric string for v1 category APIs.
The time when the component was created (ISO8601 Date time format in UTC).
The actor that created the component. This is an Autodesk / Oxygen ID.
The time when the component was last updated (ISO8601 Date time format in UTC).
The actor that last updated the component. This is an Autodesk / Oxygen ID.
The time when the component was deleted at (ISO8601 Date time format in UTC).
The actor that deleted the component. This is an Autodesk / Oxygen ID.
A flag indicating whether the component is active or inactive (isActive is true if-and-only-if deletedAt is empty).

The name of the category. Must be unique among children of the same parent category. This name is displayed
for the category in the Assets user interface where a user chooses categories.
A description of the category.

The globally-unique ID of a Category from the v3 (upcoming) Category APIs. This is provided
for interoperability with other APIs that use the globally-unique category ID. Only included if the
includeUid=true query param is included.
The ID of the category’s parent category.

Whether or not this category is the root category of the category tree. If true, it’s the root; if
false, it’s not. There will only ever be one (immutable) root category for a project, which is created
automatically when the project is created.

Whether or not this category is a leaf category of the category tree. If true, it’s a leaf; if false,
it’s not.
Note that this is a derived field and should not be persisted as this field may be updated without
updating the category itself.

An array of category IDs of this category’s child categories.
Note that this is a derived field and should not be persisted as this field may be updated without
updating the category itself. As such, it is highly recommended to use the parentId field to
construct the tree locally instead of subcategoryIds.
